title: NZ MBIE Determination 2026/033 (comparative): proposed pool barrier, immediate pool area layout
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Hastings District Council; comparative only, not Alberta
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992) as cited; F9 referenced; edition not stated in extracted text

facts.text: The authority's stated reason is that areas enclosed by the proposed barrier cannot be part of the immediate pool area for clause F9 purposes.
The owner applied for building consent on 6 May 2026, including a recreation room in the proposed immediate pool area.
The recreation room was removed after an information request from the authority.
The authority described the sauna, pool house and loggia as collectively a broader multi-use recreation and entertainment facility.
Figure 1 is a plan showing the proposed immediate pool area.
